_nameNote: 'valid.fullName' is the base name only. tests/patients/new-registration.spec.ts registers it with the next number on the end — MASUD RANA-1, MASUD RANA-2, and so on — so each run leaves a patient of its own rather than colliding with the last one. 'nameSequence' is the last number used and is written back here by the run; set it to 0 to start the series again.
